jobs.description:
You will be a member of the SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

Join our team
 

We are a restaurant awarded 
1 Michelin star and are looking for a motivated and passionate 
cook to join our kitchen team.
 

Quality, product knowledge, precision and teamwork are at the heart of our kitchen. We work with high-quality ingredients every day and strive to offer our guests a gastronomic experience at the highest level.
 

As a cook, you will have an important role within our team and contribute to the daily operation of the kitchen.
 

As a cook, you will:
 
 

•  

be responsible for your own section of the kitchen;
  

•  

prepare the mise en place and preparations for your section;
  

•  

prepare and plate dishes according to our standards;
  

•  

ensure consistent quality, taste and presentation;
  

•  

work closely with the chef and the rest of the kitchen team;
  

•  

ensure an efficient and well-organised service;
  

•  

work according to hygiene and HACCP standards;
  

•  

take proper care of ingredients, equipment and your workstation;
  

•  

actively contribute to the efficient organisation and operation of the kitchen.
  
 

•  

You have 
at least 2 years of relevant professional experience as a cook, or can demonstrate equivalent relevant knowledge and experience.
  

•  

You are organised and able to work accurately.
  

•  

You have a strong eye for detail, quality and presentation.
  

•  

You can work both independently and as part of a team.
  

•  

You speak 
Dutch or English.
  

•  

You are able to travel independently to the 
Knokke region, Belgium.

If you enjoy working on real robots in real environments and want to see your software operating in 
the field, this role offers the opportunity to make a tangible impact in a fast-growing and innovative 
sector.
 

This is what your job will look like:
 

As a robotic engineer, you will be part of our driven engineering team, where you will work together to 
develop high-quality software solutions. Your tasks will include:
 
 

• Develop, maintain, and improve robotic software using 
ROS2 

• Integrate and optimize 
navigation stacks, SLAM, and sensor fusion 

• Build perception systems using 
Computer Vision (e.g., object detection, visual localization) 

• Design and deploy 
Machine Learning models for robotic perception and autonomous decisionmaking 

• Work hands-on with real robots: system integration, deployment, tuning, and performance 
optimization 

• Contribute to robot control, localization, and path planning 

• Participate in on-site testing and customer deployments across Belgium and the Netherlands  

That's why this job suits you:
 
 

• You are hands-on and have 3-5 years of experience and strong affinity with autonomous navigation, robotics, machine control or industrial automation 

• Thorough knowledge of 
ROS2, C, C++, and Python 

• Solid knowledge in majority of the following fields: 
 

• Sensor fusion for state estimation and localization 

• Control systems for robotics 

• Path planning & Navigation (SLAM) 

• Computer Vision and Machine Learning applied to robotics   

• You’re comfortable working with hardware and in realworld field environments and experience bringing systems from prototype to reliable field deployment 

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your work 

• You have a valid EU driving license (for site testing and deployments) 

• You can communicate fluently in English

As a Network Designer within Fiber your responsibilities are: 

• Analyse the impact of internal and external triggers on the network architecture, with a focus on large to very large projects
• Consult inventory databases and other available network information as the basis for your study
• Develop a high-level or detailed design plan that describes the solution in concrete terms
• Optimise the network and keep its complexity as limited as possible
• Monitor investment and operating costs and lower them wherever possible
• Safeguard the buildability of the network, so that design and execution fit together smoothly
• Ensure the design, management and maintenance of the cable network in your region and follow up large-scale projects from start to finish

What do you bring?

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in IT, surveying, geography or a similar field
• Experience in the telecom sector
• Experience with road works and/or utility works is a strong asset
Your skills

• Good knowledge of QGIS (a must), AutoCAD or similar tools
• Good knowledge of MS Office
• Strong spatial awareness; you quickly recognise patterns in networks and maps
• An analytical mindset when approaching technical issues
• Professional communication skills in Dutch and English
Who are you?

• You work independently and organise and prioritise your work with ease
• You combine analytical insight with a practical view on feasibility
• You are flexible and stress-resistant, even when projects become large and complex
• You stay positive and constructive, even under difficult circumstances

Your responsibilities 
 

You will provide comprehensive administrative and organisational support to our lawyers.
 

Your responsibilities will include:
 

Matter and document support: opening and maintaining matters in the ERP system; preparing court documents; finalising submissions; monitoring deadlines; ensuring consistent document formatting. Financial administration: preparing and following up invoices; creating purchase requisitions and purchase orders; processing expense reports. Planning and logistics: managing calendars; organising internal and external meetings; arranging travel; coordinating hearing-related logistics. Data and compliance: maintaining CRM records and monitoring lawyers’ professional or bar-related obligations.

Essential
 

At least two years’ experience in an administrative, executive assistant or management assistant role. Excellent written and spoken Dutch and English. Proficiency in Microsoft Office. Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.  Desirable
 

Previous experience in a law firm or another professional-services environment. Working knowledge of French. Experience with ERP, document management or CRM systems.

Would you like to join an international company on a human scale in Brussels and gain valuable professional experience? We are looking for a versatile Travel & Customer Care Assistant to support the DiscoverEU team in delivering smooth travel coordination and high-quality participant support. Key Responsibilities Travel & Customer Care
 
 
 
• Respond promptly to participant enquiries via email and chat, ensuring agreed service levels are met 
 
• Coordinate travel logistics, including booking support, document verification, and expense/invoice tracking 
 
• Identify and escalate complex cases to the appropriate team members when required 
 
• Manage special travel situations (e.g. accessibility needs, lost tickets, rebookings) and maintain accurate records 
 
• Ensure compliance with internal procedures, data protection rules, and financial guidelines 
 
• Support administrative tasks and team coordination as needed 
 
• Troubleshoot participant documentation issues and follow escalation processes 
 

 Admin, IT & Tools
 
 
 
• Use internal platforms and helpdesk tools to efficiently assist participants 
 
• Work with databases, IT systems, and standard office tools 
 
• Ensure all data handling complies with GDPR and internal IT security protocols 
 
• Promote sustainability principles as part of EMAS commitments 

 
 
•   
 
• Available between June and August (with extension until September–October for German and/or Polish speakers) 
 
• Excellent command of English (written and spoken) 
 
• Good written skills in German, Dutch, and/or Polish (German and Polish are strong assets) 
 
• Strong customer service mindset and professional communication skills 
 
• Well-organised, able to manage priorities and meet deadlines 
 
• Detail-oriented, with a focus on quality, accuracy, and consistency 
 
•

Our client is a Brussels-based company operating in a technical and regulated environment, with an international scope. It stands out for its pragmatic mindset, family-oriented culture, high-quality approach and products, as well as its continuous drive to modernize internal tools and processes.As part of its digital transformation and the structuring of its IT function, our client is looking to strengthen its team by recruiting an IT Coordinator who will play a central role between users, management, and external partners.

As an IT Coordinator, you will hold a key, cross-functional position, combining both operational and organizational responsibilities.You will cover the full IT scope: user support, infrastructure, business applications, and coordination of external service providers.You will actively contribute to the company's digitalization and ensure the continuity, reliability, and ongoing development of its IT systems.Your responsibilities :

• Provide Level 1 and Level 2 IT support to users (workstations, software, access, etc.).
• Manage and maintain IT infrastructure (networks, servers, cloud environments, security).
• Administer and optimize business applications in collaboration with an external consultant (CRM, webshop, internal tools, Office 365, etc.).
• Lead IT projects (new tools, improvements, migrations) in collaboration with various departments (e.g. CRM implementation project).
• Coordinate and manage external IT vendors and service providers.
• Identify innovation opportunities and propose continuous improvements to systems and processes.
• Support users and management through change and the adoption of new tools

Profile

• Minimum 5 years of experience in an IT coordination role or similar position.
• Versatile profile, comfortable with support, infrastructure, applications, and project management.
• Experience working with external IT service providers.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 and collaborative environments.
• Excellent organizational, autonomy, and communication skills.
• Strong sense of innovation and a genuine ability to support change.
• Languages: French and English required; Dutch is a strong asset (trilingual profile is a major plus).

Our client is a large Belgian organization with an extensive and business-critical IT environment. Within the infrastructure department, work is being done on various strategic programs concerning hybrid cloud, middleware, integration platforms, networking, and cybersecurity.To further structure multiple infrastructure projects and interdependencies, they are seeking an experienced IT Infrastructure Project Manager who takes ownership of planning, stakeholders, and delivery within the domains of AppStack, Network Security, and Networking.
Jobomschrijving
Here, you assume end-to-end management of multiple complex infrastructure projects within a hybrid enterprise environment.You coordinate projects related to middleware, integration, automation, networking, and network security, ensuring that technical teams and vendors remain aligned. You translate the various project lines into concrete plans, milestones, and deliverables, and closely monitor these using tools including MS Project and Jira.You guide technical teams during implementations, migrations, and infrastructure changes, while monitoring schedules, scope, budget, resources, risks, and dependencies.You organize alignment and synchronization meetings, maintain coherence between different initiatives, and ensure transparent communication with stakeholders and management.Additionally, you oversee governance, documentation, compliance, and security requirements.

•  5y experience as Project Manager in IT-infra
• You are strong in stakeholder management and diplomacy
• Broad technical knowledge of infrastructure, cloud, middleware, integration, and security 
• Trilingual environment (English, Dutch & French): you should at least understand (not speak) them at a basic level and master one

jobs.occupation: Food Production Operator (Early, Late or Night Shift)
jobs.description:
What will you do as a Packaging Operator in the Food Industry?
 

 
• Operate, set up and monitor packaging and weighing machines
 
• Check the quality and correct weight of packaged products
 
• Identify and resolve minor malfunctions or report them in a timely manner
 
• Perform quality control checks, including metal detection tests
 
• Help maintain a clean, safe and organized working environment 

 
• Experience as an operator or with packaging machines is an advantage, but not required
 
• You work accurately and have a strong eye for quality
 
• You speak Dutch, French, or English
 
• A forklift certificate is a plus
 
• You are willing to work in a chilled environment (5°C to 10°C)
 
• You are willing to work in shifts (6:00 AM to 2:00 PM, 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM, or 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM)

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
This company repackages and stores frozen and chilled food products for numerous European businesses. These services are tailored to the specific needs of each customer. By 2025, the company aims to employ more than 300 people, who together handle 25,000 unique packaging orders. Working for this company means being part of a respectful environment where strong teamwork and dedication to the job go hand in hand.

Your responsibilities as a Reach Truck Operator include:

 
• 
Carrying out inspections and checks on incoming and outgoing goods.

 
• 
Placing incoming products in the correct locations within the warehouse and preparing outgoing goods for shipment.

 
• 
Scanning products into the system once they have been stored in the appropriate location.

 
• 
Primarily operating a reach truck, while also being comfortable using a forklift truck and pallet truck when required.

Interested? Read on to find out if you qualify!

 
• 
You are ready to work in the fixed nightshift.

 
• 
You hold a valid reach truck certificate.

 
• 
You already have some experience operating a reach truck. Stacking goods up to 10 meters high does not intimidate you.

 
• 
You are able to communicate in English with your colleagues.

 
• 
You will be working in a frozen warehouse at -18°C, operating an enclosed, heated reach truck. Appropriate protective clothing will also be provided by the company.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
This company (re)packs and stores frozen and refrigerated food products for numerous European companies. They do this for each customer. By 2027, the company aims to have 300+ employees working on 25 000 unique packaging assignments. Working in this company means working in a respectful environment, where a great bond between employees and dedication to work go hand in hand.

As a Quality Controller, you work closely with the quality and production teams to ensure that our products not only meet the strictest standards, but also end up on store shelves with pride.

 
• 
80% inspections on the workfloor/production <> 20% desk work (registration/documentation of performed checks)

 
• 
Visual inspections of packaging and labeling

 
• 
Monitoring quality standards and improving them where possible

 
• 
Providing support during audits or certifications (BRC, IFS, Organic, customer audits...)

 
• 
Coaching among employees to strengthen quality awareness

Does reading this set of responsibilities already spark your interest? Read on and find out what we expect from you:

 
• 
A bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience in a food production environment

 
• 
Experience with BRC and IFS standards

 
• 
A good knowledge of Dutch and English, allowing you to communicate smoothly with colleagues

 
• 
You have a critical mindset and a strong eye for detail

 
• 
Your insights and observations contribute to maintaining and improving the quality level of our products

 
• 
You are willing to work in a cold environment (5–10 °C), including about half an hour per day performing checks in the freezer (-18 °C)

 
• 
You are comfortable working with MS Office and Outlook
